items.heading: Information We Collect
items.body: We collect the information you provide directly to us. When you submit our contact form, we collect your name, company name, email address, phone number (optional), the service you're interested in, and your message. When you subscribe to our newsletter, we collect your email address. We do not use cookies or website analytics to track your browsing activity on this site.

items.heading: How We Use Your Information
items.body: We use the information you provide to respond to your consultation request, understand your business needs, and follow up about our services. If you subscribe to our newsletter, we use your email address to send periodic updates about finance and accounting topics relevant to GCC businesses. We do not sell your information to third parties.

items.heading: How We Share Your Information
items.body: Contact form submissions are sent directly to our own email inbox using our email provider's infrastructure -- no third-party form service ever receives or stores your submission. Newsletter signups are processed by our email marketing provider, which stores your email address to deliver the newsletter and manage unsubscribes. We do not share your information with any other third party except where required by law.

items.heading: Data Retention
items.body: We retain contact form submissions for as long as reasonably necessary to respond to your inquiry and maintain business records. Newsletter subscriptions are retained until you unsubscribe, which you can do at any time using the link in any newsletter email.

items.heading: Your Rights
items.body: You can ask us at any time what information we hold about you, request that we correct or delete it, and withdraw consent to future contact. To exercise any of these rights, email us at info@frontierquotient.com. We will respond within a reasonable time.

items.heading: Data Security
items.body: We take reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect the information you share with us. No method of transmission over the internet is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security, but we limit access to your information to what's needed to respond to you.

items.heading: Changes to This Policy
items.body: We may update this policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or for legal reasons. The "Last updated" date at the top of this page reflects when it was last revised.

items.heading: Contact Us
items.body: If you have questions about this policy or how we handle your information, email us at info@frontierquotient.com.
